description:
The HUD speed readout on the /fly route shows 'NaN km/s' during the cruise phase of any outer-planet mission (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres).

Expected: The HUD speed readout shows a finite, physically plausible speed (km/s) throughout the entire cruise for every destination, including outer planets. The vis-viva-based speed follows the correct transfer ellipse semi-major axis for the destination.

Acceptance criteria:
- data-helio-kms on the fly-render-state element is a finite number (not NaN, not ±Infinity) for every outer-planet mission at every simulated time step from departure to arrival
- The speed readout in the HUD (.hud-val) shows a finite number for outer-planet missions
- The velocity arrow length (calculated from heliocentricKms) is a finite number for outer-planet missions
- The speed readout for inner-planet missions (Mercury, Venus) remains finite and unchanged (not NaN — already finite, numerically wrong is a separate concern)
